ZONINGLOTDEVELOPMENTAGREEMENT THIS ZONING LOT DEVELOPMENT AGREEMENT (this "Agreement"), made as of February 13, 2026 ("Effective Date"), by WOODSIDE 86 REALTY, LLC,having an address at 200 Birch Drive, Roslyn, NY 11576 (hereinafter referred to as "Owner"). WITNESSEH: WHEREAS, Owner is the owner in fee title of a certain parcel of land, with the known as Block 1296, Tax Lots 42 and more particularly described by metes and bound in Exhibit A(hereinafter known as "ParcelA")and Block 1296,TaxLot 43andmore particularly described by metes and bounds in Exhibit B (hereinafter known as "Parcel B"). Parcel A and Parcel B are collectively known as "Owner's Property" and are herein sometimes jointly referred to as the "Parcels" and each individually as a "Parcel") WHEREAS, in contemplation of construction of a new building upon Parcel B (said new building, with any further additions, alterations and replacements thereof, being herein called the "New Building"), Owner previously utilized the procedure available under the Zoning Resolution for combining Parcels A and B of Owner's Property into a single "zoning lot" for the purpose of ensuring that the New Building's floor area (herein referred to as "Floor Area"), as that term is defined in section 12 -10 of the Zoning Resolution of the City of New York effective December 15, 1961 (the "Zoning Resolution") complies with the "floor area ratio"limitation contained in the Zoning Resolution. (hereinafter defined) appurtenant to the Owner's Property comprising Parcel A and Parcel B which are in excess of the Floor Area Development Rights utilized on the Owner's Property as of the Effective Date. As used in this Agreement, the term "Floor Area Development Rights" shall mean the rights, as determined in accordance with the Zoning Resolution, which are appurtenant to a zoning lot, to develop such zoning lot by erecting thereon a structure or structures with a total floor area determined by (i) multiplying the area of such Zoning lot by the basic maximum allowable floor area ratio for structures in the zoning district in which such zoning lot is located, and (ii) the inclusion of any available bonus floor area and any use, bulk, density and other development rights permitted under the Zoning Resolution; WHEREAS, in order to construct the New Building on Parcel B, Owner intends to both reserve and use on or pertinent to Parcel B, all Available Development Rights from the Owner's Property pursuant to the terms of this Agreement.
